text: I am running for the mothers and fathers who feel powerless against the public school systems that strip away parental rights to control what and how their children are taught.
I am running for the victims of crimes, which are increasing at an alarming rate.
I am running for the working class and everyone whose economic freedom is being slowly stolen through increasing taxes and burdensome government regulation.
I am running to restore faith in our electoral process so that no legal voter is disenfranchised by the belief that the system is rigged.
